patch_description: This design combines two signals rather than relying only on direct-link rewards and selected two-hop paths. It uses demand-aware two-hop candidates, but adapts how many intermediates it retains: close-ranked alternatives are kept, while clearly weaker ones are omitted. Separately, it adds sparse positive couplings between links entering or leaving the same heavily loaded node. These couplings act as a quadratic proxy for transit congestion, complementing the negative path couplings that reward useful two-hop service. All weights are demand-normalized and the number of couplings stays within the stated limit.
